scope: Synthetic PSD operators H with trace(H squared) normalized except an explicit scale control; not data-derived EFA fits, not timing evidence.
method: Production seeded Rademacher probes and uncertainty summary; independent orthogonal-factor application; exhaustive all-sign check at N=8.

worstCase.attainedBy: rank-one H squared with equal diagonal entries; a dense equal-magnitude eigenvector (balanced signs can preserve centering)
worstCase.qualification: A bound on RMS Monte Carlo error over independent random probes, not a bound on one run or a rigorous confidence interval.
